/**
   * Verify an S/MIME signature.
   *
   * @param verifyFlags - Optional flags from nsICMSVerifyFlags.
   *
   * @returns The reason for failure verification, if verification failed.
   */
  nsISMimeVerificationFailure verifySignature(in long verifyFlags);

  /**
   * Verify a detached S/MIME signature.
   *
   * @param verifyFlags - Optional flags from nsICMSVerifyFlags.
   * @param aDigestData - The data for the signature digest.
   * @param aDigestType - The digest algorithm type.
   *
   * @returns The reason for failure verification, if verification failed.
   */
  nsISMimeVerificationFailure verifyDetachedSignature(
    in long verifyFlags,
    in Array<octet> aDigestData,
    in int16_t aDigestType);
